cases.title: Search messages no results
cases.brief:
Restore every masked restoration stage identified below.

Restoration stage 1 - add_heart_reaction_to_architecture_message:
Restore message reactions across the chat and Activity surfaces: users should be able to choose an emoji on a message, have that reaction persisted in their workspace state, and browse reacted messages through Activity’s reaction filter.

Restoration stage 2 - view_reacted_engineering_message:
Restore the Activity workflow for opening a reacted message in its originating channel or direct-message conversation by selecting the message from the Reactions view.

Restoration stage 3 - edit_message_and_download_attachment:
Restore the engineering-channel workflow for editing one of the current user's messages and downloading its image attachment from the message card.

Restoration stage 4 - search_message_and_view_channel:
Restore the global search workflow so a user can open search from the current channel, search across messages, channels, and people, and navigate from a matching conversation result to view it.

Restoration stage 5 - update_and_pin_engineering_message:
Restore the workflow for updating an existing engineering-channel message and pinning it from the message actions, including frontend state synchronization and backend persistence of the pin.

Restoration stage 6 - edit_pinned_message_and_view_pins:
Restore the pinned-message review workflow in a channel: after editing an already pinned message, users should be able to open the channel’s pinned messages panel and inspect the pinned conversation entries there.

Restoration stage 7 - delete_pinned_channel_message:
Restore the ability to delete a pinned channel message from its message action controls, spanning the channel UI, client state/API integration, and backend message persistence used by the pinned-messages surface.

Restoration stage 8 - search_messages_no_results:
Restore TeamChat’s global-search empty state so that opening search from a channel and entering a query with no matches across messages, channels, or people presents the intended no-results experience.

The restoration is complete only when every masked restoration stage works.

cases.brief:
Restore every masked restoration stage identified below.

Restoration stage 1 - create_postgresql_rds_database:
Restore the RDS PostgreSQL database creation workflow across the databases and database-detail surfaces: users should be able to open the creation form, choose a template and instance/storage settings, provide database credentials, create the database, and review its saved configuration.

Restoration stage 2 - create_manual_database_snapshot:
Restore manual RDS database snapshot creation on the Snapshots page, including the snapshot list, the creation dialog for choosing an existing DB instance and entering a snapshot identifier, and the state lifecycle needed to surface the requested snapshot.

Restoration stage 3 - stop_reporting_database:
Restore the RDS database stop workflow on the Databases page so a user can select an available database and invoke the stop action, with the console managing the asynchronous lifecycle change.

Restoration stage 4 - start_rds_database:
Restore the RDS database start workflow so users can select a stopped database instance from the databases list, initiate startup, and then inspect the instance details.

Restoration stage 5 - delete_manual_db_snapshot:
Restore the RDS manual snapshot deletion workflow from the Snapshots list, including the row-level deletion action, state update, and user feedback while preserving snapshot creation and other RDS operations.

Restoration stage 6 - delete_rds_database:
Restore RDS database deletion so users can select a database in the Databases list and delete it through the list action controls, with the operation handled by application state.

The restoration is complete only when every masked restoration stage works.
